notes.title: Huge September Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]This first week of September we have been bringing you non stop updates from bug patches to quality of life and this major list is us showing you we are devoted and will not stop until you love our game!
[/h1]

[b][h3]First of let's start with my favorite updates:[/h3][/b]
[b][list]
[*] ⦁	Changed mainmap under elven city entirely with new areas
[*] ⦁	Optimized AI combat so it's not so easy with strafing sub enemies
[*] ⦁	lowered ambient music 50% so can hear voiced dialogue
[*] ⦁	fixed arena cutscene 100% complete with SFX that means the cutscene is textured and has full voice dialogue and sound effects
[*] ⦁	made it so certain areas discovered now have fast travel and exp gain when discovering new region of map! (Basically fast travel landmarks are here!) 
[*] ⦁	added sound effects to levelups & at level 10 it will notify you in an epic way that you may now enter the dragon's crypt
[*] ⦁	useful landmark icons
[*] ⦁	added heal/block effect to dragon-bull tutorial boss
[*] ⦁	patched show hint notifications
[*] ⦁	fixed hp bar across the board for all Bosses (the hp bar appears and re-appears based on distance)
[*] ⦁	saber tooth tigers spawn near highest ice mountains also in an ice caves like baby polar bears
[*] ⦁	made dragon bull have a timer to look at player for charging correctly
[*] ⦁	add water footstep SFX to new areas on map
[*] ⦁	allow to pull out torch when unarmed/torch bugs 
[*] ⦁	physical dmg shows up for dropped items now
[*] ⦁	Alieron inner dialogue text(it's a start)
[*] ⦁	collision for elven city parts fixed
[*] ⦁	fixed anti-gravity issues with AI/objects
[*] ⦁	different species of dragonbull spawn near dragon crypt & inside
[*] Plus a lot more small things forgot to mention
[*] 
[*] We know this is mostly end game content for the dragon boss fight but we are getting the place ready!
[*] ⦁	dragon crypt map optimized
[*] ⦁	elven bounty hunter spawns inside dragoncrypt
[*] ⦁	lockpicked chests now added and lockpicks dropped by elven bounty hunter
[*] ⦁	added working ladders to dragoncrypt
[*] ⦁	made swinging pendelum traps work to kill players
[*] ⦁	add lizard paladin guards to have dodge -> then small awesome heal effect
[/list][/b]

[h1]Please be on the look out for our very own first Developer Blog that will be released by our head developer/creator on youtube this month that showcases some of the epic things we have coming up and we worked on! Have a great September be sure we are always on discord to take your suggestions and working on improving the game.[/h1]
Thank you for reading this!

notes.title: Several Bug fixes & Quality of life updates
notes.notes:
[h1]We noticed players had a few complaints about the loading screen for older PC models, so we have hired alpha testers & have fixed any issues and even optimized the game to all sorts of graphic cards![/h1]

[list]
[*] 1)Right click to place way-point icon on map (also press ESC to exit map) ☑️
[*] 
[*] 2)Reset aggro of NPCs after death  ☑️
[*] 
[*] 3)Map UI bug fixed  ☑️
[*] 
[*] 4)Terrain glitches clipping through floor fixed ☑️
[*] 
[*] 5)Made swimming faster  ☑️
[*] 
[*] 6)Active quest while on map  ☑️
[*] 
[*] 7)Horse unable to fly glitch fixed  ☑️
[*] 
[*] 8)Fixed death glitch respawning with 0hp bug that occured rarely ☑️
[*] 
[*] 9)Removed the starting health potion so not to be confused with quest item potion  ☑️
[*] 
[*] 10) fixed horse mounting bug (sometimes wouldn't let you re-mount horse after dismounting) ☑️
[*] 
[*] We also fixed small bug with stairs not being able to walk up them only run, and some quest bugs added snow near snow troll cave.
[/list]

[h2]In the near future, we hope to include even more quality of life updates to make the game fun.
Based on your feedback and the testers of the game, we want to extend a sincere thank you to all who have had the patience to help us with this early access title. We look forward to not disappointing you and bringing you a game. You will continue to find new fun content every update![/h2]

notes.title: Optimization Update 1.0.7 RELEASED!
notes.notes:
[b]Our development team has been up long nights 24/7 for 2 weeks optimizing the game.[/b] The changes are astronomical we hired a new Unreal engine professional engineer with a decade of experience and we are pleased to announce that we have listened to so many of your bug reports via discord etc. We would love you to try the new and improved early acces[u]s. The performance should not be a problem anymore[/u]. 

[h2]Also the next updates we have planned shall go in this order: [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Controller Support
[*] Combat tutorial+Werewolf introduction mini boss 
[*] Introduction story cutscene 
[*] Voiced dialogue for all AI dialogue
[*] More of your bug reports & feedback to make the game an overall more better experience!
[/olist]
ːsteamthumbsupː

If I can give a rough ETA for these updates I would say by end of June. I will keep you updated via discord and our forums. Expect a devblog for all the upcoming changes to see how far we've come on our youtube channel.
[h1]Thankyou for being a part of molding our game :)[/h1]
